eng_text: The case was prosecuted in Virginia because it is the home to the leading internet service provider AOL, the company who instigated the charges.

eng_text: This is the first time a conviction has been gained using the legislation enacted in 2003 to curb bulk e-mail, aka spam, from unsolicited distribution into users mailboxes.

eng_text: Dr. Lee also expressed his concern about reports that children in Turkey have now become infected with the A(H5N1) avian influenza virus without becoming ill.

eng_text: Some studies suggest that the disease must become less lethal before it can cause a global epidemic, he noted.

eng_text: There is concern that patients may continue to infect more people by going through their daily routines if the flu symptoms remain mild.

text: D'Leslie Aun, eng Spriecherin vun der Komen Foundation, huet gesot, datt d'Organisatioun eng nei Reegel adoptéiert, déi et net erlaabt, datt Subventiounen oder Finanzéierungen un eng Organisatioun vergi ginn, géint déi rechtlech ermëttelt gëtt.
eng_text: Leslie Aun, a spokesperson for the Komen Foundation, said the organization adopted a new rule that does not allow grants or funding to be awarded to organizations that are under legal investigation.

eng_text: Komen's policy disqualified Planned Parenthood due to a pending investigation on how Planned Parenthood spends and reports its money that is being conducted by Representative Cliff Stearns.

eng_text: Former Massachusetts governor Mitt Romney won the Florida Republican Party presidential primary election on Tuesday with over 46 percent of the vote.

eng_text: Former U.S. Speaker of the House Newt Gingrich came in second with 32 percent.

eng_text: As a winner-takes-all state, Florida awarded all fifty of its delegates to Romney, pushing him ahead as the front-runner for the Republican Party nomination.

eng_text: Organisers of the protest said about 100,000 people turned up in German cities such as Berlin, Cologne, Hamburg, and Hanover.

eng_text: In Berlin, police estimated 6,500 protestors.

eng_text: Protests also took place in Paris, Sofia in Bulgaria, Vilnius in Lithuania, Valetta in Malta, Tallinn in Estonia, and Edinburgh and Glasgow in Scotland.

eng_text: Last month, there were major protests in Poland when that country signed ACTA, which has led to the Polish government deciding not to ratify the agreement, for now.

eng_text: Animal Liberation and the Royal Society for the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals (RSPCA) are again calling for the mandatory installation of CCTV cameras in all Australian abattoirs.

eng_text: RSPCA New South Wales chief inspector David O'Shannessy told the ABC that surveillance and inspections of abattoirs should be commonplace in Australia.

eng_text: "The CCTV would certainly send a strong signal to those people working with animals that their welfare is of the highest priority."

eng_text: Japanese judoka Hitoshi Saito, winner of two Olympic gold medals, has died at the age of 54.

eng_text: The cause of death was announced as intrahepatic bile duct cancer.

eng_text: The first economic reforms were made under the leadership of Deng Xiaoping.

eng_text: Since then, China's economic size has grown by 90 times.

eng_text: Tropical Storm Danielle, fourth named storm of the 2010 Atlantic hurricane season, has formed in the eastern Atlantic Ocean.

eng_text: The storm, located approximately 3,000 miles from Miami, Florida, has maximum sustained winds of 40 mph (64 kph).

eng_text: He joined them in 1945 and stayed until 1958.

eng_text: While on his warm-up lap, Lenz fell off his bike, and was then struck by fellow racer Xavier Zayat.

eng_text: He was immediately attended to by the on-track medical staff and transported to a local hospital where he later died.

eng_text: Zayat was unhurt in the accident.

eng_text: Regarding the global financial situation, Zapatero continued by saying that "the financial system is a part of the economy, a crucial part.

eng_text: We have a year-long financial crisis, which has had its most acute moment in the past two months, and I think now the financial markets are beginning to recover."

eng_text: Last week, Naked News announced that it would dramatically increase its international language mandate to news reporting, with three new broadcasts.

eng_text: Already reporting in English and Japanese, the global organization is launching Spanish, Italian, and Korean-language programs, for television, the web, and mobile devices.

eng_text: "Luckily nothing happened to me, but I saw a macabre scene, as people tried to break windows in order to get out.

eng_text: People were hitting the panes with chairs, but the windows were unbreakable.

eng_text: One of the panes finally broke, and they started to get out by the window," said survivor Franciszek Kowal.

text: Stäre strale wéinst der Energie, déi entsteet, wa Waasserstoffatomer zu schwéieren Elementer zesumme verschmëlzen (oder fusionéieren), fir méi schwéier Elementer ze bilden, Liicht an Hëtzt of.
eng_text: Stars give off light and heat because of the energy made when hydrogen atoms are merged (or fused) together to form heavier elements.

text: Wëssenschaftler schaffen drun, e Reakter ze schafen, deen op déi selwecht Weis Energie produzéiere kann.
eng_text: Scientists are working to create a reactor that can make energy in the same way.

eng_text: This, however, is a very hard problem to solve and will take many years before we see useful fusion reactors built.

text: D'Stolnol schwëmmt opgrond vun der Uewerflächespannung um Waasser.
eng_text: The steel needle floats on top of the water because of surface tension.

text: Uewerflächespannung entsteet, well d'Waassermoleküllen un der Waasseruewerfläch méi staark vuneneen ugezu ginn ewéi d'Loftmoleküllen iwwer hinnen.
eng_text: Surface tension happens because the water molecules at the surface of the water are strongly attracted to each other more than they are to the air molecules above them.

text: D'Waassermolekülle bilden eng onsichtbar Haut op der Waasseruewerfläch, déi et Saachen ewéi der Nol erméiglechen, um Waasser ze schwiewen.
eng_text: The water molecules make an invisible skin on the water’s surface that allows things like the needle to float on top of the water.

text: D'Kouf vun engem moderne Schlittschong huet eng duebel Kant mat enger konkaver Kaul dertëschent. Déi zwou Kanten erméiglechen eng besser Grëffegkeet um Äis, och wann d'Kouf schréi steet.
eng_text: The blade on a modern ice skate has a double edge with a concave hollow between them. The two edges allow for a better grasp of the ice, even when tilted.

text: Well de Buedem vum Blat liicht gekrëmmt ass, krëmmt sech och d'Kant, déi a Kontakt mam Äis ass, wa sech d'Blat vun enger Säit op déi aner neigt.
eng_text: Because the bottom of the blade is slightly curved, as the blade tilts to one side or the other, the edge which is in contact with the ice also curves.

text: Doduerch dréint sech de Schliitschongfuerer. Wa sech d'Schlittschong no riets neigen, dréint sech de Schlittschongfuerer no riets, wa sech d'Schlittschong no lénks neigen, dann dréint sech de Schlittschongfuerer no lénks.
eng_text: This causes the skater to turn. If the skates tilt to the right, the skater turns right, if the skates tilt to the left, the skater turns left.

text: Fir hire viregten Energieniveau zeréckzekréien, musse si d'zousätzlech Energie, déi si vum Liicht kritt hutt, lassginn.
eng_text: To return to their previous energy level, they must get rid of the extra energy they got from the light.

text: Se maachen dat, andeem se e winzegt Liichtdeelchen, "Photon" genannt, emittéieren.
eng_text: They do this by emitting a tiny particle of light called a "photon".

text: Wëssenschaftler nennen dëse Prozess "stimuléiert Stralungsemissioun", well d'Atomer vum helle Liicht stimuléiert ginn, wat d'Emissioun vun engem Liichtphoton verursaacht, a Liicht ass eng Aart Stralung.
eng_text: Scientists call this process "stimulated emission of radiation" because the atoms are stimulated by the bright light, causing the emission of a photon of light, and light is a type of radiation.

text: Dat nächst Bild weist d'Atomer, déi Photonen emittéieren. Natierlech si Photonen a Wierklechkeet vill méi kleng ewéi déi um Bild.
eng_text: The next picture shows the atoms emitting photons. Of course, in reality photons are a lot smaller than those in the picture.

text: Photone sinn esouguer méi kleng ewéi d'Material, dat Atomer bilt!
eng_text: Photons are even smaller than the stuff that makes up atoms!

text: No Honnerte Betribsstonne brennt den Drot vun der Bier iergendwann duerch an d'Bier funktionéiert net méi.
eng_text: After hundreds of hours of operation the filament in the bulb eventually burns out and the light bulb no longer works.

text: D'Bier muss dann ersat ginn. Beim Ersetze vun der Bier muss een oppassen.
eng_text: The light bulb then needs replacing. It is necessary to be careful in replacing the light bulb.

text: Fir d'éischt muss de Schalter fir d'Luuchthalterung ausgeschalt oder de Kabel getrennt ginn.
eng_text: First, the switch for the light fixture needs to be turned off or the cable disconnected.

text: Dat läit dorun, datt de Stroum, deen an d'Steckdous fléisst, wou de metalleschen Deel vun der Bier sëtzt, Iech e schwéiere Stroumschlag verpasse kann, wann Dir de banneschten Deel vun der Steckdous oder d'Metallbasis vun der Bier beréiert, wärend se sech nach deelweis an der Fassung befënnt.
eng_text: This is because electricity flowing into the socket where the metallic part of bulb sits can give you a severe electric shock if you touch the inside of the socket or the metal base of the bulb while it is still partly in the socket.

text: D'Haaptorgan vum Kreeslafsystem ass d'Häerz, dat d'Blutt pompelt.
eng_text: The major organ of the circulatory system is the heart, which pumps the blood.

text: D'Blutt geet vum Häerz a Réiercher, déi Arterie genannt ginn, a kënnt an de Veene genannte Réiercher zeréck an d'Häerz. Déi klengst Réiercher gi Kapillare genannt.
eng_text: Blood goes away from the heart in tubes called arteries and comes back to the heart in tubes called veins. The smallest tubes are called capillaries.

text: D'Zänn vun engem Triceratops wieren an der Lag gewiescht, net nëmmen d'Blieder, mee och déi ganz zéi Äscht a Wuerzelen ze zermalmen.
eng_text: A triceratops' teeth would have been able to crush not only leaves but even very tough branches and roots.

text: E puer Wëssenschaftler denken, datt den Triceratops Cycadee giess huet, wat eng Planzenaart ass, déi an der Kräidzäit heefeg war.
eng_text: Some scientists think Triceratops ate cycads, which are a type of plant that was common in the Cretaceous.

text: Dës Planze gesinn aus ewéi eng kleng Palm mat enger Kroun aus schaarfen, stachelege Blieder.
eng_text: These plants look like a small palm tree with a crown of sharp, spiky leaves.

text: En Triceratops hätt mat sengem staarke Schniewel d'Blieder ofsträife kënnen, éier en de Stamm giess hätt.
eng_text: A Triceratops could have used its strong beak to strip off the leaves before eating the trunk.

text: Aner Wëssenschaftler argumentéieren, datt dës Planze ganz gëfteg sinn, wouduerch et als onwarscheinlech gëllt, datt en Dinosaurier se giess hätt, obwuel hautdesdaags d'Fauldéier an aner Déieren ewéi de Papagei (en Nokomme vum Dinosaurier) gëfteg Blieder oder Friichten iessen kënnen.
eng_text: Other scientists argue that these plants are very poisonous so it is unlikely that any dinosaur ate them, even though today the sloth and other animals like the parrot (a descendant of the dinosaurs) can eat poisonous leaves or fruit.

text: Wéi géif d'Schwéierkraaft vun Io op mech wierken? Wann Dir op der Uewerfläch vun Io stoe géift, da géift Dir manner weien ewéi op der Äerd.
eng_text: How would Io's gravity pull on me? If you stood on the surface of Io, you would weigh less than you do on Earth.

text: Eng Persoun, déi op der Äerd 90 kg (200 Pond) weit, géif op Io 16 kg (36 Pond) weien. D'Schwéierkraaft üübt also manner Drock op een aus.
eng_text: A person who weighs 200 pounds (90kg) on Earth would weigh about 36 pounds (16kg) on Io. So the gravity, of course, pulls less on you.

text: D'Sonn huet keng Kuuscht ewéi d'Äerd, op där ee stoe kann. Déi ganz Sonn besteet aus Gaser, Feier a Plasma.
eng_text: The Sun doesn't have a crust like the Earth that you can stand on. The whole Sun is made out of gases, fire, and plasma.

text: De Gas gëtt méi dënn, wat ee méi wäit vum Mëttelpunkt vun der Sonn ewech ass.
eng_text: The gas becomes thinner as you go farther from the center of the Sun.

text: De baussechten Deel, dee mir gesinn, wa mir an d'Sonn kucken, gëtt Fotosphär genannt, wat "Liichtkugel" bedeit.
eng_text: The outer-part we see when we look at the Sun is called the photosphere, which means "ball of light".

text: Ongeféier dräidausend Joer méi spéit, am Joer 1610, huet den italieeneschen Astronom Galileo Galilei en Teleskop benotzt, fir ze beobachten, datt d'Venus Phasen huet, genee esou ewéi de Mound.
eng_text: About three thousand years later, in 1610, Italian astronomer Galileo Galilei used a telescope to observe that Venus has phases, just as the moon does.

text: Phasen trieden op, well nëmmen déi Säit vun der Venus (oder vum Mound), déi der Sonn zougewant ass, beliicht gëtt. D'Phase vun der Venus ënnerstëtzen d'Theorie vum Kopernikus, datt d'Planéiten ëm d'Sonn kreesen.
eng_text: Phases happen because only the side of Venus (or of the Moon) facing the Sun is lighted. The phases of Venus supported the theory of Copernicus that the planets go around the Sun.

text: Dunn, e puer Joer méi spéit am Joer 1639 huet en engleschen Astronom mam Numm Jeremiah Horrocks en Transit vun der Venus beobacht.
eng_text: Then, a few years later in 1639, an English astronomer named Jeremiah Horrocks observed a transit of Venus.

text: England huet no der Zeréckeroberung vun den Danelaw eng laang Zäit vum Fridden erlieft.
eng_text: England had experienced a long period of peace after the reconquest of the Danelaw.

text: Am Joer 991 gouf den Æthelred awer mat enger Wikingerflott konfrontéiert, déi méi grouss war ewéi all déi aner zanter där vum Guthrum ee Joerhonnert méi fréi.
eng_text: However in 991 Ethelred was faced with a Viking fleet larger than any since Guthrum's a century earlier.

text: Den Olaf Trygvasson, en Norweger, dee säi Land vun der dänescher Herrschaft zeréckeruewere wollt, huet déi Flott ugeféiert.
eng_text: This fleet was led by Olaf Trygvasson, a Norwegian with ambitions to reclaim his country from Danish domination.

text: No ufängleche militäresche Réckschléi war den Æthelred an der Lag e Vertrag mam Olaf auszehandelen, deen dono an Norwegen zeréckgaangen ass, fir ze versichen, säi Kinnekräich mat gemëschtem Erfolleg zeréckzekréien.
eng_text: After initial military setbacks, Ethelred was able to agree to terms with Olaf, who returned to Norway to try to gain his kingdom with mixed success.

text: Hangeul ass dat eenzegt absichtlech entwéckelt Alphabet am populären deegleche Gebrauch. D'Alphabet gouf 1444 wärend der Herrschaft vum Kinnek Sejong (1418 – 1450) entwéckelt.
eng_text: Hangeul is the only purposely invented alphabet in popular daily use. The alphabet was invented in 1444 during the reign of King Sejong (1418 – 1450).

text: De Kinnek Sejong war de véierte Kinnek vun der Joseon-Dynastie an hien ass ee vun den ugesinnsten.
eng_text: King Sejong was the fourth king of the Joseon Dynasty and is one of the most highly regarded.

text: Hien huet d'Hangeul-Alphabet ursprénglech Hunmin Jeongeum genannt, wat "de richtegen Toun fir d'Instruktioun vum Vollek" bedeit.
eng_text: He originally named the Hangeul alphabet Hunmin Jeongeum, which means "the correct sounds for the instruction of the people".

text: Et gëtt vill Theorien doriwwer, wéi Sanskrit entstanen ass. Eng vun hinnen handelt vun enger arescher Migratioun aus dem Westen no Indien, déi hir Sprooch mat sech bruecht huet.
eng_text: There are many theories to how Sanskrit came into existence. One of them is about an Aryan migration from the west into India who brought their language with them.

text: Sanskrit ass eng al Sprooch a vergläichbar mat Latäin an Europa.
eng_text: Sanskrit is an ancient language and is comparable to the Latin language spoken in Europe.

text: Dat fréist bekannt Buch vun der Welt gouf a Sanskrit geschriwwen. No der Zesummestellung vun den Upanishaden ass Sanskrit nëmmen opgrond vun der Hierarchie a Vergiessenheet geroden.
eng_text: The earliest known book in the world was written in Sanskrit. After the compilation of Upanishads, Sanskrit just faded due to hierarchy.

text: Sanskrit ass eng ganz komplex a räich Sprooch, déi als Quell fir vill modern indesch Sproochen gedéngt huet, genee esou ewéi Latäin d'Quell fir europäesch Sproochen ewéi Franséisch a Spuenesch ass.
eng_text: Sanskrit is a very complex and rich language, which has served to be the source for many modern Indian languages, just like Latin is the source for European languages like French and Spanish.

text: No der Schluecht ëm Frankräich huet Däitschland ugefaangen, sech op d'Eroberung vun der Brittescher Insel virzebereeden.
eng_text: With the battle for France over, Germany began to get ready to invade the island of Britain.

text: Däitschland huet dem Ugrëff de Codenumm 'Unternehmen Seelöwe' ginn. Déi meescht schwéier Waffen a Reserve vun der brittescher Arméi si bei der Evakuéierung aus Dunkerke verluer gaangen, esoudatt d'Arméi zimmlech schwaach war.
eng_text: Germany code-named the attack “Operation Sealion”. Most of the British Army's heavy weapons and supplies had been lost when it evacuated from Dunkirk, so the army was fairly weak.

text: Awer d'Royal Navy war ëmmer nach vill méi staark ewéi d'däitsch Kriegsmarine an hätt jiddwer Invasiounsflott zerstéiere kënnen, déi iwwer den Äermelkanal geschéckt gi wier.
eng_text: But the Royal Navy was still much stronger than the German Navy (“Kriegsmarine”) and could have destroyed any invasion fleet sent across the English Channel.

text: E puer Royal-Navy-Schëffer waren awer nobäi vun de warscheinlechen Invasiounsstrecke stationéiert, well d'Admireel Angscht haten, se géife vun däitsche Loftugrëffer versenkt.
eng_text: However, very few Royal Navy ships were based near the likely invasion routes as the admirals were afraid they would be sunk by German air attack.

text: Loosst eis mat enger Erklärung iwwer d'Pläng vun Italien ufänken. Italie war virun allem de "klenge Brudder" vun Däitschland a Japan.
eng_text: Let's start with an explanation about Italy's plans. Italy was mainly the "little brother" of Germany and Japan.

text: Se hat eng méi schwaach Arméi an eng méi schwaach Marine, obwuel se grad virum Krichsufank véier nei Schëffer gebaut haten.
eng_text: It had a weaker army and a weaker navy, although they had just built four new ships right before the beginning of the war.

text: D'Haaptziler vun Italie waren afrikanesch Länner. Fir dës Länner ze eroberen, hu se Truppenausgangsbasisse gebraucht, fir datt Truppen iwwer d'Mëttelmier fueren an Afrika erobere konnten.
eng_text: Italy's main goals were African countries. To capture those countries, they would need to have a troop launching pad, so as troops could sail across the Mediterranean Sea and invade Africa.

text: Dofir hu se d'brittesch Basissen a Schëffer an Ägypte musse lass ginn. Ofgesi vun deenen Aktioune sollten déi italieenesch Schluechtschëffer näischt anescht maachen.
eng_text: For that, they had to get rid of British bases and ships in Egypt. Besides those actions, Italy's battleships were not supposed to do anything else.

text: Komme mir elo zu Japan. Japan war en Inselstaat, genee ewéi Groussbritannien.
eng_text: Now for Japan. Japan was an island country, just like Britain.

text: U‑Booter si Schëffer, déi fir Reesen ënner Waasser konzipéiert sinn a fir e längeren Zäitraum do bleiwen.
eng_text: Submarines are ships designed to travel underwater, and remain there for an extended amount of time.

text: U‑Booter goufen am Éischten an Zweete Weltkrich benotzt. Deemools ware se ganz lues an haten eng ganz limitéiert Schéissautonomie.
eng_text: Submarines were used in World War I and World War II. Back then they were very slow and had a very limited shooting range.

text: Um Ufank vum Krich si se meeschtens um Mier gereest, awer wéi de Radar entwéckelt gouf an ugefaangen huet, ëmmer méi genee ze ginn, waren d'U‑Booter gezwongen, ënner Waasser ze goen, fir net gesinn ze ginn.
eng_text: In the beginning of the war they mostly travelled on top of the sea, but as radar began developing and becoming more accurate the submarines were forced to go under water to avoid being seen.

text: Däitsch U‑Booter goufen 'U‑Boote' genannt. Déi Däitsch ware ganz gutt an der Navigatioun an der Bedéngung vun hiren U‑Booter.
eng_text: German submarines were called U-Boats. The Germans were very good at navigating and operating their submarines.

text: Wéinst hirem Erfolleg mat U-Booter, hunn déi Däitsch nom Krich der net méi vill däerfen hunn.
eng_text: Because of their success with submarines, after the war Germans aren't trusted to have many of them.

text: Jo! De Pharao Tutenchamun, deen heiansdo och "Pharao Tut" oder "Kandpharao" genannt gëtt, ass ee vun de bekanntste Pharaoen aus dem Alen Ägypten an der Neizäit.
eng_text: Yes! King Tutankhamun, sometimes referred to as "King Tut" or "The Boy King", is one of the most well known ancient Egyptian kings in modern times.

text: Interessanterweis gouf hien an der Antik net als esou wichteg ugesinn a gouf net op de Lëschte vun den eelste Kinneke geféiert.
eng_text: Interestingly, he was not considered to be very important in ancient times and was not recorded on most ancient king lists.

text: Awer d'Entdeckung vu sengem Graf am Joer 1922 huet hien zu enger Berüümtheet gemaach. Wärend vill Griewer aus der Vergaangenheet ausgeraibert goufen, war dëst Graf praktesch ongestéiert gelooss ginn.
eng_text: However, the discovery of his tomb in 1922 made him a celebrity. While many tombs of the past were robbed, this tomb was left virtually undisturbed.

text: Déi meescht Géigestänn, déi mam Tutenchamun begruewe goufen, si gutt erhalen, dorënner Dausende vun Aartefakten aus Eedelmetaller a rar Steng.
eng_text: Most of the items buried with Tutankhamun have been well preserved, including thousands of artefacts made from precious metals and rare stones.

text: D'Erfindung vun de Speecherieder huet assyresch Sträitween méi liicht, méi séier a besser virbereet gemaach, fir méi séier ewéi Zaldoten an aner Sträitween ze sinn.
eng_text: The invention of spoke wheels made Assyrian chariots lighter, faster, and better prepared to outrun soldiers and other chariots.

text: Bolzen aus hiren déidlechen Aarmbrëscht konnten duerch d'Rüstung vu rivaliséierenden Zaldoten dréngen. Ëm 1000 v. Chr. hunn d'Assyrer déi éischt Kavallerie ageféiert.
eng_text: Arrows from their deadly crossbows could penetrate the armor of rival soldiers. About 1000 B.C., the Assyrians introduced the first cavalry.

text: Eng Kavallerie ass eng Arméi, déi um Päerd kämpft. De Suedel war nach net erfonnt, also huet d'assyresch Kavallerie um plakege Réck vun hire Päerd gekämpft.
eng_text: A cavalry is an army that fights on horseback. The saddle had not yet been invented, so the Assyrian cavalry fought on the bare backs of their horses.

text: Mir kenne vill griichesch Politiker, Wëssenschaftler a Kënschtler. Déi wuel bekanntst Persoun vun dëser Kultur ass den Homer, de legendäre blannen Dichter, deen zwee Meeschterwierker vun der griichescher Literatur geschriwwen huet: d'Gedichter Ilias an Odyssee.
eng_text: We know many Greek politicians, scientists, and artists. Possibly the most known person of this culture is Homer, the legendary blind poet, who composed two masterpieces of Greek literature: the poems Iliad and Odyssey.

text: De Sophokles an den Aristophanes si weiderhi beléift Dramatiker an hir Stécker zielen zu de grousse Wierker vun der Weltliteratur.
eng_text: Sophocles and Aristophanes are still popular playwrights and their plays are considered to be among the greatest works of world literature.

text: En anere bekannte Griich ass de Mathematiker Pythagoras, deen haaptsächlech fir säin Theorem iwwer d'Relatioune vun de Säite vu rechtwénkelegen Dräiecker berüümt ass.
eng_text: Another famous Greek is a mathematician Pythagoras, mostly known for his famous theorem about relations of the sides of right triangles.

text: Et gëtt ënnerschiddlech Schätzungen, wéi vill Mënschen Hindi schwätzen. Et gëtt geschat, datt et déi zweet- bis véiertheefegst geschwat Sprooch vun der Welt ass.
eng_text: There are varying estimates for how many people speak Hindi. It is estimated to be between the second and fourth most commonly spoken language in the world.

text: D'Zuel vun de Mammesproochler variéiert jee nodeem, ob ganz enk verwannt Dialekter matgezielt sinn oder net.
eng_text: The number of native speakers varies depending on whether or not very closely related dialects are counted.

text: Schätzunge gi vun 340 Millioune bis 500 Millioune Mënschen, déi d'Sprooch schwätzen, a bis zu 800 Millioune Mënsche kënne se verstoen.
eng_text: Estimates range from 340 million to 500 million speakers, and as many as 800 million people can understand the language.

text: Hindi an Urdu sinn am Wuertschatz änlech, awer an der Schrëft ënnerschiddlech; an alldeegleche Konversatioune kënne sech Spriecher vu béide Sproochen normalerweis verstoen.
eng_text: Hindi and Urdu are similar in vocabulary but different in script; in everyday conversations, speakers of both languages can usually understand each other.

text: Ëm d'15. Joerhonnert huet Däitschland Nordestland kulturell staark beaflosst.
eng_text: Around the 15th century, northern Estonia was under great cultural influence of Germany.

text: E puer däitsch Mënche wollten den Urawunner Gott méi no bréngen, also hu se d'estnesch wiertlech Sprooch erfonnt.
eng_text: Some German monks wanted to bring God closer to the native people, so they invented the Estonian literal language.

text: Se baséiert um däitschen Alphabet a gouf ëm een Zeechen "Õ/õ" erweidert.
eng_text: It was based on the German alphabet and one character "Õ/õ" was added.

text: Am Laf vun der Zäit si vill Wierder verschmolt, déi aus dem Däitschen entléint goufen. Dat war den Ufank vun der Erliichtung.
eng_text: As time passed, many words that were borrowed from German coalesced. This was the beginning of enlightenment.

text: Traditionell géif den Trounfollger nom Ofschloss vun der Schoul direkt dem Militär bäitrieden.
eng_text: Traditionally, the heir to the throne would go straight into the military after finishing school.

text: Den Charles huet awer d'Universitéit um Trinity College (Cambridge) besicht, wou hien Anthropologie an Archeologie a spéider Geschicht studéiert, a mat 2:2 (enger niddereger zweetklassescher Nott) ofgeschloss huet.
eng_text: However, Charles went to university at Trinity College, Cambridge where he studied Anthropology and Archaeology, and later History, earning a 2:2 (a lower second class degree).

text: Den Charles war den éischte Member vun der brittescher Kinneksfamill, deen en Ofschloss gemaach huet.
eng_text: Charles was the first member of the British Royal Family to be awarded a degree.

text: D'europäesch Tierkei (Ostthrakien oder Rumelien op der Balkanhallefinsel) ëmfaasst 3 % vum Land.
eng_text: European Turkey (eastern Thrace or Rumelia in the Balkan peninsula) includes 3% of the country.

text: D'Gebitt vun der Tierkei ass méi ewéi 1 600 Kilometer (1 000 Meile) laang an 800 km (500 Meile) breet, mat enger rechteckeger Form.
eng_text: The territory of Turkey is more than 1,600 kilometres (1,000 mi) long and 800 km (500 mi) wide, with a roughly rectangular shape.

text: D'Gebitt vun der Tierkei, inklusiv de Séien, ëmfaasst 783 562 Quadratkilometer (300 948 Quadratmeilen), dovu 755 688 Quadratkilometer (291 773 Quadratmeilen) a Südwestasien an 23 764 Quadratkilometer (9 174 Quadratmeilen) an Europa.
eng_text: Turkey's area, including lakes, occupies 783,562 square kilometres (300,948 sq mi), of which 755,688 square kilometres (291,773 sq mi) are in south west Asia and 23,764 square kilometres (9,174 sq mi) in Europe.

text: D'Gebitt vun der Tierkei mécht et zum 37. gréisste Land vun der Welt an ass ongeféier esou grouss ewéi d'France métropolitaine an d'Vereenegt Kinnekräich zesummen.
eng_text: Turkey's area makes it the world's 37th-largest country, and is about the size of Metropolitan France and the United Kingdom combined.

text: D'Tierkei läit tëschent dräi Mieren: d'Ägäis am Westen, d'Schwaarzt Mier am Norden an d'Mëttelmier am Süden.
eng_text: Turkey is encircled by seas on three sides: the Aegean Sea to the west, the Black Sea to the north and the Mediterranean Sea to the south.

text: Lëtzebuerg bléckt op eng laang Geschicht zeréck, awer seng Onofhängegkeet huet et eréischt 1839 erlaangt.
eng_text: Luxembourg has a long history but its independence dates from 1839.

text: Deeler vun der Belsch vun haut hunn an der Vergaangenheet zu Lëtzebuerg gehéiert, goufen awer no der Belscher Revolutioun an den 1830er Belsch.
eng_text: Present-day parts of Belgium were part of Luxembourg in the past but became Belgian after the 1830s Belgian Revolution.

text: Lëtzebuerg huet ëmmer versicht neutral ze bleiwen, awer et esouwuel am Éischten ewéi och am Zweete Weltkrich huet Däitschland et besat.
eng_text: Luxembourg has always tried to remain a neutral country but it was occupied in both World War I and World War II by Germany.

text: 1957 gouf Lëtzebuerg e Grënnungsmember vun der Organisatioun, déi haut als Europäesch Unioun bekannt ass.
eng_text: In 1957 Luxembourg became a founding member of the organization which is today known as the European Union.

text: D'Drukgyal Dzong ass eng zerstéiert Festung an e buddhistesche Klouschter am ieweschten Deel vum Distrikt Paro (am Duerf Phondey).
eng_text: The Drukgyal Dzong is a ruined fortress and Buddhist monastery in the upper part of the Paro District (in Phondey Village).

text: Et gëtt gesot, datt am Joer 1649 den Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel d'Festung geschaf huet, fir u seng Victoire géint d'tibetesch-mongolesch Sträitkräeften ze erënneren.
eng_text: It is said that in 1649, Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel created the fortress to commemorate his victory against the Tibetan-Mongol forces.

text: 1951 huet e Brand dozou geféiert, datt nëmme munch Reliquië vun Drukgyal Dzong ewéi d'Bild vum Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal erhale bloufen.
eng_text: In 1951, a fire caused for only some of the relics of the Drukgyal Dzong to remain, such as the image of Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal.

text: Nom Feier gouf d'Festung erhalen a geschützt an ass esoumat eng vun de sensationellsten Attraktioune vu Bhutan bliwwen.
eng_text: After the fire, the fortress was preserved and protected, remaining to be one of Bhutan's most sensational attractions.

text: Wärend dem 18. Joerhonnert huet sech Kambodja tëschent zwee mächteg Noperen, Thailand a Vietnam, gequëtscht.
eng_text: During the 18th century Cambodia found itself squeezed between two powerful neighbors, Thailand and Vietnam.

text: D'Thailänner sinn am 18. Joerhonnert e puer Mol a Kambodja agefall an hunn Phnom Phen am Joer 1772 zerstéiert.
eng_text: The Thais invaded Cambodia several times in the 18th century and in 1772 they destroyed Phnom Phen.

text: Enn vum 18. Joerhonnert sinn d'Vietnameesen och a Kambodja agefall.
eng_text: In the last years of the 18th century the Vietnamese also invaded Cambodia.

text: Uechtzéng Prozent vun de Venezuelaner sinn aarbechtslos an déi meescht Beschäftegt schaffen an der informeller Wirtschaft.
eng_text: Eighteen percent of Venezuelans are unemployed, and most of those who are employed work in the informal economy.

text: Zwee Drëttel vun de schaffende Venezuelaner sinn am Déngschtleeschtungssecteur täteg, bal ee Véierel schafft an der Industrie, ee Fënneftel an der Landwirtschaft.
eng_text: Two thirds of Venezuelans who work do so in the service sector, nearly a quarter work in industry and a fifth work in agriculture.

text: Eng wichteg Industrie fir d'Venezuelaner ass Pëtrol, woubäi d'Land en Nettoexporteur ass, obwuel just ee Prozent an der Uelegindustrie schafft.
eng_text: An important industry for Venezuelans is oil, where the country is a net exporter, even though only one percent work in the oil industry.

text: Schonn um Ufank vun der Onofhängegkeet vum Land huet d'Expertis vum Singapore Botanic Garden dobäi gehollef, d'Insel an eng tropesch Gaardestad ze verwandelen.
eng_text: Early in the nation's independence, Singapore Botanic Gardens' expertise helped to transform the island into a tropical Garden City.

text: 1981 gouf Vanda Miss Joaquim, en Orchideeënhybrid, als Nationalblumm vun der Natioun gewielt.
eng_text: In 1981, Vanda Miss Joaquim, an orchid hybrid, was chosen as the nation's national flower.

text: All Joer ëm den Oktober zéie bal 1,5 Millioune Planzefriesser aus den nërdleche Bierger wéinst dem Reen a Richtung vun de südlechen Eebenen iwwer de Mara.
eng_text: Every year around October nearly 1.5 million herbivores travel towards the southern plains, crossing the Mara River, from the northern hills for the rains.

text: An dunn zeréck duerch de Westen an den Norden, nach eng Kéier iwwer de Mara no de Reefäll vum Abrëll.
eng_text: And then back to the north through the west, once again crossing the Mara river, after the rains in around April.

text: D'Serengeti-Regioun ëmfaasst de Serengeti-Nationalpark, d'Ngorongoro Conservation Area an d'Maswa Game Reserve an Tansania an d'Maasai Mara National Reserve a Kenia.
eng_text: The Serengeti region contains the Serengeti National Park, the Ngorongoro Conservation Area and Maswa Game Reserve in Tanzania and the Maasai Mara National Reserve in Kenya.

text: Ze léieren interaktiv Medien ze schafen, erfuerdert konventionell an traditionell Fäegkeeten esouwéi an interaktive Coursë gemeeschtert Geschier (Storyboarding, Audios- a Videosbeaarbechtung, Storytelling asw.).
eng_text: Learning to create interactive media requires conventional and traditional skills, as well as tools mastered in interactive classes (storyboarding, audio and video editing, story telling, etc.)

text: Interaktiven Design erfuerdert, datt Dir eng Vermuddung iwwer d'Medieproduktioun nei bewäert a léiert, net-linear ze denken.
eng_text: Interactive design requires that you re-assess your assumptions about media production and learn to think in a non-linear ways.

text: Interaktiven Design erfuerdert, datt Komponente vun engem Projet matenee verbonne sinn, awer och als separat Eenheet sënnvoll sinn.
eng_text: Interactive design requires that components of a project connect to each other, but also make sense as a separate entity.

text: Den Nodeel vu Zoomobjektiver ass, datt d'Brennwäit an d'Zuel vun den Objektivelementer, déi erfuerderlech sinn, fir e Brennwäitberäich ze erreechen, vill méi grouss ewéi bei Festbrennwäiten ass.
eng_text: The disadvantage of zoom lenses is that the focal complexity and number of lens elements required to achieve a range of focal lengths is much greater than for prime lenses.

text: Dat gëtt ëmmer manner zu engem Problem, well Objektivhiersteller méi héich Standarden an der Objektivproduktioun erreechen.
eng_text: This is becoming less of an issue as lens manufacturers achieve higher standards in lens production.

text: Doduerch konnte Zoomobjektiver Biller an enger Qualitéit schafen, déi mat der Qualitéit vun Objektiver mat fester Brennwäit vergläichbar ass.
eng_text: This has allowed zoom lenses to produce pictures of a quality comparable to that achieved by lenses with fixed focal length.

text: En aneren Nodeel vu Zoomobjektiver ass, datt d'maximal Apertur (d'Geschwindegkeet) vun der Lëns normalerweis méi niddereg ass.
eng_text: Another disadvantage of zoom lenses is that the maximum aperture (the speed) of the lens is usually lower.

text: Doduerch si präisgënschteg Zoomobjektiver bei schlechte Liichtverhältnisser ouni Blëtz nëmme schwéier ze verwenden.
eng_text: This makes inexpensive zoom lenses hard to use in low-light conditions without a flash.

text: Ee vun den heefegste Problemer, wann ee versicht, e Film an den DVD-Format ze konvertéieren, ass den Overscan.
eng_text: One of the most common problems when trying to convert a movie to DVD format is the overscan.

text: Déi meescht Fernseeër sinn op eng Manéier produzéiert, fir d'allgemeng Ëffentlechkeet ze erfreeën.
eng_text: Most televisions are made in a way to please the general public.

text: Aus dësem Grond hat alles, wat een um Fernsee gesinn huet, d'Ränner ofgeschnidden, uewen, ënnen an op de Säiten.
eng_text: For that reason, everything you see on the TV had the borders cut, top, bottom and sides.

text: Doduerch gëtt séchergestallt, datt d'Bild de gesamte Bildschierm ofdeckt. Dat nennt een Overscan.
eng_text: This is made to ensure that the image covers the whole screen. That is called overscan.

text: Leider ginn d'Ränner héchstwarscheinlech och geschnidden, wann Dir eng DVD maacht, a wann d'Ënnertitele vum Video ze no un der Ënnersäit waren, gi se net vollstänneg ugewisen.
eng_text: Unfortunately, when you make a DVD, it's borders will most likely be cut too, and if the video had subtitles too close to the bottom, they won't be fully shown.

text: Déi traditionell mëttelalterlech Buerg huet scho laang d'Fantasie inspiréiert a Biller vun Tjosten, Banqueten an Artus-Rittertum eropbeschwuer.
eng_text: The traditional medieval castle has long inspired the imagination, conjuring up images of jousts, banquets and Arthurian chivalry.

text: Och wann ee matzen an dausendjärege Ruine steet, ass et einfach, un d'Geräicher a Gerécher vu laang vergaangene Schluechten ze denken, bal d'Klibbere vun Houf op de Paveesteng ze héieren an d'Angscht aus de Kerkergrouwen ze richen.
eng_text: Even standing amidst thousand year-old ruins it is easy to bring to mind the sounds and smells of battles long gone, to almost hear the clatter of hooves on the cobbles and to smell the fear rising from the dungeon pits.

text: Awer baséiert eis Virstellung op der Realitéit? Firwat goufe Schlässer iwwerhaapt gebaut? Wéi goufe se entworf a gebaut?
eng_text: But is our imagination based on reality? Why were castles built in the first place? How were they designed and built?

text: Typesch fir d'Zäit, ass Kirby Muxloe Castle méi e befestegt Haus ewéi e richtegt Schlass.
eng_text: Typical for the period, Kirby Muxloe Castle is more of a fortified house than a true castle.

text: Déi grouss verglaast Fënsteren an dënn Wänn hätten engem entschlossenen Ugrëff net laang widderstoe kënnen.
eng_text: Its large glazed windows and thin walls would not have been able to resist a determined attack for long.

text: An den 1480er, wéi de Bau vum Lord Hastings ugefaange gouf, war d'Land relativ friddlech an et huet ee sech nëmme géint kleng Gruppe vu ronderëmzéiende Marodeure verteidege missen.
eng_text: In the 1480s, when its construction was begun by Lord Hastings, the country was relatively peaceful and defense was only required against small bands of roving marauders.

text: D'Kräfteverhältnis war e System, an deem europäesch Natiounen d'national Selbstbestëmmung vun allen europäesche Staate wollten oprecht halen.
eng_text: The balance of power was a system in which European nations sought to maintain the national sovereignty of all European states.

text: D'Konzept war, datt all europäesch Natioune versichen hu missen, eng Natioun dorun ze hënneren, mächteg ze ginn, an esou hunn d'national Regierungen dacks hir Allianze gewiesselt, fir d'Gläichgewiicht ze erhalen.
eng_text: The concept was that all European nations had to seek to prevent one nation from becoming powerful, and thus national governments often changed their alliances in order to maintain the balance.

text: De Spueneschen Ierffollegskrich war den éischte Krich, deem säin zentraalt Theema d'Gläichgewiicht vum Kräfteverhältnis war.
eng_text: The War of Spanish Succession marked the first war whose central issue was the balance of power.

text: Dat war eng wichteg Verännerung, well d'europäesch Mächten de Virwand net méi hätten, datt et sech ëm Reliounskricher handelt. Esou wier den Drëssegjärege Krich de leschte Krich, deen als Reliounskrich bezeechent gëtt.
eng_text: This marked an important change, as European powers would no longer have the pretext of being religious wars. Thus, the Thirty Years' War would be the last war to be labeled a religious war.

text: Den Tempel vun der Artemis zu Ephesos gouf den 21. Juli 356 v. Chr. bei enger Brandstëftung duerch den Herostratos zerstéiert.
eng_text: The temple of Artemis at Ephesus was destroyed on July 21, 356 BCE in an act of arson committed by Herostratus.

text: Laut der Geschicht war seng Motivatioun Rum ëm jiddwer Präis. D'Epheser, ausser sech, hunn ugekënnegt, datt dem Herostratos säin Numm nimools niddergeschriwwe géif.
eng_text: According to the story, his motivation was fame at any cost. The Ephesians, outraged, announced that Herostratus' name never be recorded.

text: De griicheschen Historiker Strabo huet spéider den eis bekannten Numm opgeschriwwen. Den Tempel gouf an där Nuecht zerstéiert, an där den Alexander de Grousse gebuer gouf.
eng_text: The Greek historian Strabo later noted the name, which is how we know today. The temple was destroyed on the same night that Alexander the Great was born.

text: Den Alexander huet als Kinnek ugebueden, fir den Erëmopbau vum Tempel ze bezuelen, awer seng Offer gouf ofgeleent. Spéider, nom Doud vum Alexander, gouf den Tempel am Joer 323 v. Chr. erëm opgebaut.
eng_text: Alexander, as king, offered to pay to rebuild the temple, but his offer was denied. Later, after Alexander died, the temple was rebuilt in 323 BCE.

text: Stellt sécher, datt Är Hand esou entspaant ewéi méiglech ass an Dir all Noute richteg trefft – versicht och, net ze vill Friembeweegunge mat Äre Fangeren ze maachen.
eng_text: Make sure your hand is as relaxed as possible while still hitting all the notes correctly - also try not to make much extraneous motion with your fingers.

text: Esou verausgaabt Dir Iech esou wéineg ewéi méiglech. Denkt drun, et besteet keng Noutwennegkeet, d'Tasten ewéi um Piano mat vill Kraaft ze drécken, fir méi Lautstäerkt ze kréien.
eng_text: This way, you will tire yourself out as little as possible. Remember there's no need to hit the keys with a lot of force for extra volume like on the piano.

text: Op engem Akkordeon verwent Dir de Faleballeg mat méi Drock oder Geschwindegkeet, fir zousätzlech Lautstäerkt ze kréien.
eng_text: On the accordion, to get extra volume, you use the bellows with more pressure or speed.

text: Mystizismus ass d'Striewen no Kommunioun mat, Identitéit mat oder bewosster Sensibiliséierung fir eng ultimativ Realitéit, Gottheet, spirituell Wouerecht oder Gott.
eng_text: Mysticism is the pursuit of communion with, identity with, or conscious awareness of an ultimate reality, divinity, spiritual truth, or God.

text: De Gleewege sicht eng direkt Erfarung, Intuitioun oder Asiicht an d'gëttlech Realitéit/d'Gottheet oder Gottheeten.
eng_text: The believer seeks a direct experience, intuition, or insight into divine reality/the deity or dieties.

text: Unhänger verfollege bestëmmt Liewensweisen oder Praktiken, déi dës Erfarunge fërdere sollen.
eng_text: Followers pursue certain ways of living, or practices that are intended to nurture those experiences.

text: Mystizismus kann duerch seng Betounung vun der direkter perséinlecher Erfarung vun engem eenzegaartege Bewosstsinnszoustand, virun allem déi mat engem friddlechen, verständnisvollen, gléckséilegen oder esouguer extatesche Charakter vun anere Forme vum reliéise Glawen an der Ubiedung ënnerscheet ginn.
eng_text: Mysticism can be distinguished from other forms of religious belief and worship by its emphasis on the direct personal experience of a unique state of consciousness, particularly those of a peaceful, insightful, blissful, or even ecstatic character.

text: Sikhismus ass eng Relioun vum indesche Subkontinent. Et ass wärend dem 15. Joerhonnert aus enger sektéierescher Spaltung bannent der hinduistescher Traditioun an der Punjab-Regioun entstanen.
eng_text: Sikhism is a religion from the Indian sub-continent. It originated in the Punjab region during the 15th century from a sectarian split within the Hindu tradition.

text: D'Sikhe gesinn hire Glawen als gesonnert Relioun vum Hinduismus, obwuel se hir hinduistesch Wuerzelen an Traditiounen unerkennen.
eng_text: Sikhs consider their faith to be a separate religion from Hinduism though they acknowledge its Hindu roots and traditions.

text: De Sikhen hir Relioun heescht Gurmat, wat Punjabi fir "de Wee vum Guru" ass. De Guru ass e fundamentalen Aspekt vun allen indesche Reliounen, awer am Sikhismus huet en eng Bedeitung ugeholl, déi de Häerzstéck vum Sikh-Glawe bilt.
eng_text: Sikhs call their religion Gurmat, which is Punjabi for "way of the guru". The guru is a fundamental aspect of all Indian religions but in Sikhism has taken on an importance that forms the core of Sikh beliefs.

text: D'Relioun gouf am 15. Joerhonnert vum Guru Nanak (1469 – 1539) gegrënnt. Dorop sinn néng weider Gurue gefollegt.
eng_text: The religion was founded in the 15th century by Guru Nanak (1469–1539). There followed in succession a further nine gurus.

text: Am Juni 1956 goufen d'Versprieche vum Chruschtschow awer op d'Prouf gestallt, wéi d'Onrouen a Polen, wou d'Aarbechter géint d'Narungsmëttelknappheet a Lounkierzunge protestéiert hunn, an en allgemenge Protest géint de Kommunismus ëmgeschloe sinn.
eng_text: However, in June 1956, Krushchev's promises were put to the test when riots in Poland, where workers were protesting against food shortages and wage cuts, turned into a general protest against Communism.

text: Obwuel de Chruschtschow schlussendlech Panzere geschéckt huet, fir d'Uerdnung erëm hierzestellen, huet hien e puer wirtschaftleche Fuerderungen zougestëmmt a sech bereet erkläert, de beléifte Wladyslaw Gomulka zum neie Premierminister ze ernennen.
eng_text: Although in the end, Krushchev sent in tanks to restore order, he did give way to some economic demands and agreed to appoint the popular Wladyslaw Gomulka as the new prime minister.

text: D'Induskultur war eng Bronzezäitzivilisatioun am nordwestlechen indesche Subkontinent, deen de gréissten Deel vum moderne Pakistan an e puer Regiounen am Nordweste vun Indien an am Nordoste vun Afghanistan ëmfaasst.
eng_text: The Indus Valley Civilization was a Bronze Age civilisation in the northwest Indian subcontinent encompassing most of modern-day Pakistan and some regions in northwest India and northeast Afghanistan.

text: D'Zivilisatioun ass am Becke vum Indus opgebléit, vun deem se och hiren Numm kritt huet.
eng_text: The civilisation flourished in the basins of the Indus River wherefore it derives its name.

text: Wann och e puer Wëssenschaftler spekuléieren, datt well d'Kultur och am Becke vum elo ausgedréchente Sarasvati existéiert huet, se passend d'Indus-Sarasvati-Kultur genannt sollt ginn, gëtt se deelweis och wéinst Harappa, dem éischte vun hiren 1920 ausgegruewene Siten, Harappa-Kultur genannt.
eng_text: Although some scholars speculate that since the civilisation also existed in the basins of the now dried up Sarasvati River, it should be aptly called the Indus-Sarasvati Civilization, while some call it the Harappan Civilization after Harappa, the first of its sites to be excavated in the 1920s.

text: D'militaristesch Natur vum réimesche Räich huet d'Entwécklung vun de medezinesche Fortschrëtter ënnerstëtzt.
eng_text: The militaristic nature of the Roman empire aided in the development of medical advances.

text: D'Dokteren hunn ugefaange vum Keeser Augustus rekrutéiert ze ginn an hunn esouguer den éischte réimesche medezinesche Corps fir den Asaz no Schluechte gebilt.
eng_text: Doctors began to be recruited by Emperor Augustus and even formed the first Roman Medical Corps for use in the aftermath of battles.

text: Chirurgen hate Kenntnisser iwwer verschidde Berouegungsmëttel inklusiv Morphium aus Extrakter vu Feierblummesom a Scopolamin aus Bilsekraut.
eng_text: Surgeons had knowledge of various sedatives including morphine from extracts of poppy seeds and scopolamine from herbane seeds.

text: Se goufen dichteg mat Amputatiounen, fir Patiente vu Wondbrand ze retten, esouwéi mat Tourniqueten an Arteeriëklemmen, fir de Bluttfloss ze stoppen.
eng_text: They became proficient at amputation to save patients from gangrene as well as tourniquets and arterial clamps to stem blood flow.

text: Am Laf vun e puer Joerhonnerten huet d'Réimescht Räich zu groussen Errongenschaften um Gebitt vun der Medezin geféiert a bilde vill vun deem, wat mir haut wëssen.
eng_text: Over multiple centuries, the Roman empire led to great gains in the field of medicine and formed much of the knowledge we know today.

text: Pureland-Origami ass Origami mat der Aschränkung, datt nëmmen eng Fal gläichzäiteg duerchgeféiert däerf ginn, méi komplext Falen ewéi ëmgekéiert Falen ass net erlaabt an all Falen hunn onkomplizéiert Plazen.
eng_text: Pureland origami is origami with the restriction that only one fold may be done at a time, more complex folds like reverse folds are not allowed, and all folds have straightforward locations.

eng_text: It was developed by John Smith in the 1970s to help inexperienced folders or those with limited motor skills.

text: Kanner entwéckelen zimmlech jonk e Bewosstsi fir Rass a rassesch Stereotyppen an dës rassesch Stereotyppe beaflossen d'Verhalen.
eng_text: Children develop an awareness of race and racial stereotypes quite young and these racial stereotypes affect behavior.

text: Kanner, déi sech zum Beispill mat enger rassescher Minoritéit identifizéieren, déi net als esou gutt an der Schoul ugesi gëtt, tendéieren dozou, net esou gutt an der Schoul ze sinn, wa se iwwer de mat hirer Rass verbonnene Stereotyp léieren.
eng_text: For instance, children who identify with a racial minority that is stereotyped as not doing well in school tend to not do well in school once they learn about the stereotype associated with their race.

text: MySpace ass den drëttbeléiftste genotzten Internetsite an de Vereenegte Staaten an huet den Ament 54 Millioune Profiller.
eng_text: MySpace is the third most popular website used in the United States and has 54 million profiles currently.

text: Dës Internetsitten hu vill Opmierksamkeet kritt, virun allem an der Bildung.
eng_text: These websites have gotten a lot of attention, especially in the education setting.

text: Et gëtt positiv Aspekter fir dës Internetsitten, déi ëmfaassen, datt een an der Lag ass, eng Klasssäit anzeriichten, déi Bloggen, Videoen, Fotoen an aner Funktiounen enthale kann.
eng_text: There are positive aspects to these websites, which include, being able to easily setup a class page which can include blogs, videos, photos, and other features.

text: Op dës Säit kann einfach zougegraff ginn, andeem nëmmen eng Webadress ugi gëtt, wat et fir Studenten, déi Problemer mat der Tastatur oder der Orthographie hunn, einfach ze mierken an anzegi mécht.
eng_text: This page can easily be accessed by providing just one web address, which makes it easy to remember and easy to type in for students who may have trouble using the keyboard or with spelling.

text: Et kann ugepasst ginn, fir d'Liesen ze erliichteren, an och mat esou vill Faarf ewéi gewënscht.
eng_text: It can be customized to make it easy to read and also with as much or little color as desired.

text: Den Opmierksamkeetsdefizitsyndrom "ass en neurologesche Syndrom, deem seng klassesch definéierend Symptomertriad Impulsivitéit, Oflenkbarkeet an Hyperaktivitéit oder ze vill Energie ëmfaassen".
eng_text: Attention Deficit Disorder "is a neurological syndrome whose classic defining triad of symptoms including impulsivity, distractibility, and hyperactivity or excess energy".

text: Et ass keng Léierbehënnerung, et ass eng Léierstéierung; se "betrëfft 3 bis 5 Prozent vun alle Kanner, vläicht gutt 2 Milliounen amerikanesch Kanner".
eng_text: It is not a learning disability, it is a learning disorder; it "affects 3 to 5 percent of all children, perhaps as many as 2 million American children".

text: Kanner mat ADHS kënne sech nëmme schwéier op Saachen ewéi Schoulaufgabe konzentréieren, awer se kënne sech op Saache konzentréieren ewéi Spiller spillen oder hir Liiblingscomicken kucken oder Sätz ouni Sazzeeche schreiwen.
eng_text: Children with ADD have a hard time focusing on things like school work, but they can concentrate on things they enjoy doing like playing games or watching their favorite cartoons or writing sentences without punctuation.

text: Dës Kanner neigen dozou, vill Ierger ze kréien, well se sech "riskant verhalen, a Kämpf geroden an d'Autoritéit erausfuerderen", fir hiert Gehier ze stimuléieren, well hiert Gehier net iwwer normal Methode stimuléiert ka ginn.
eng_text: These children tend to get into a lot of trouble, because they "engage in risky behaviors, get into fights, and challenge authority" in order to stimulate their brain, since their brain can not be stimulated by normal methods.

text: ADHS kann d'Bezéiunge mat anere Gläichaltrege beaflossen, well déi aner Kanner net kënne verstoen, firwat se esou handelen, wéi se handelen; oder firwat esou buschtawéieren, wéi se buschtawéieren; oder firwat hiren Entwécklungsniveau ënnerschiddlech ass.
eng_text: ADD affects relationships with other peers because other children can not understand why they act the way that they do or why they spell they way they do or that their maturity level is different.

text: Well sech d'Fäegkeet Wëssen ze erlaangen an ze léieren op eng Aart a Weis verännert huet, ewéi uewen erwäänt, huet sech de Basistaux verännert, mat deem Wëssen erlaangt gëtt.
eng_text: As the ability to obtain knowledge and to learn changed in such a way as mentioned above the base rate at which knowledge was obtained changed.

text: Den Usaz Informatiounen ze kréie war anescht. Den Drock louch net méi an der individueller Erënnerung, mee d'Fäegkeet Text ofzeruffen ass méi an de Fokus geréckelt.
eng_text: The approach to obtaining information was different. No longer did pressure reside within individual recall, but the ability to recall text became more of a focus.

text: Am Weesentlechen huet d'Renaissance eng weesentlech Ännerung an der Erugangsweis un d'Léieren an d'Verbreedung vu Wësse bruecht.
eng_text: In essence, the Renaissance made a significant change in the approach to learning and the dissemination of knowledge.

text: Am Géigesaz zu anere Primate benotzen Hominiden hir Hänn net méi fir d'Fortbeweegung oder d'Droe vu Gewiicht oder d'Schwéngen duerch d'Beem.
eng_text: Unlike other primates, hominids no longer use their hands in locomotion or bearing weight or swinging through the trees.

text: D'Hand an de Fouss vum Schimpans sinn a Gréisst a Längt änlech, wat d'Verwende vun der Hand fir d'Droe vum Gewiicht beim Knéchelgang erëmspigelt.
eng_text: The chimpanzee's hand and foot are similar in size and length, reflecting the hand's use for bearing weight in knuckle walking.

text: D'Hand vum Mënsch ass méi kuerz ewéi de Fouss, mat méi riichte Fangerglidder.
eng_text: The human hand is shorter than the foot, with straighter phalanges.

text: Zwee bis dräi Millioune Joer al fossil Handschanke weisen dës Verschibung an der Spezialiséierung vun der Hand vu Fortbeweegung zu Manipulatioun,
eng_text: Fossil hand bones two million to three million years old reveal this shift in specialization of the hand from locomotion to manipulation.

text: E puer Leit gleewen, datt d'Erliewe vu ville kënschtlech ausgeléiste luziden Dreem oft genuch zimmlech ustrengend ka sinn.
eng_text: Some people believe that experiencing many artificially induced lucid dreams often enough can be very exhausting.

text: Den Haaptgrond fir dëse Phenomen ass, datt luzid Dreem dozou féieren, d'Längt vun der Zäit tëschent de REM-Zoustänn ze erweideren.
eng_text: The main reason for this phenomenon is the result of the lucid dreams expanding the length of time between REM states.

text: Mat manner REMe pro Nuecht, gëtt dësen Zoustand, an deem een eigentlech schléift an de Kierper sech erhëlt, seele genuch, fir zu engem Problem ze ginn.
eng_text: With fewer REMs per night, this state in which you experience actual sleep and your body recovers becomes infrequent enough to become a problem.

text: Dat ass genee esou ustrengend, ewéi wann Dir all 20 oder 30 Minutten erwächen a Fernsee kucke géift.
eng_text: This is just as exhausting as if you were to wake up every twenty or thirty minutes and watch TV.

text: D'Auswierkung hänkt dovun of, wéi dacks Äert Gehier pro Nuecht versicht, luzid ze dreemen.
eng_text: The effect is dependent on how often your brain attempts to lucidly dream per night.

text: Fir d'Italieener ass et an Nordafrika vun Ufank un net wierklech gutt gelaf. Bannent enger Woch no der Krichserklärung vun Italien den 10. Juni 1940 haten d'brittesch 11. Hussaren de Fort Capuzzo a Libyen ageholl.
eng_text: Things did not go well for the Italians in North Africa almost from the start. Within a week of Italy's declaration of war on June 10, 1940, the British 11th Hussars had seized Fort Capuzzo in Libya.

text: An engem Hinterhalt ëstlech vu Bardia hunn d'Britten de Chefingenieur vun der italieenescher Zéngter Arméi, de Generol Lastucci, gefaange geholl.
eng_text: In an ambush east of Bardia, the British captured the Italian Tenth Army's Engineer-in-Chief, General Lastucci.

text: Den 28. Juni gouf de Marschall Italo Balbo, de Generalgouverneur vu Libyen an offensichtlechen Ierwe vum Mussolini, bei der Landung zu Tobruk duerch Beschoss duerch eegen Truppen ëmbruecht.
eng_text: On June 28, Marshal Italo Balbo, the Governor-General of Libya and apparent heir to Mussolini, was killed by friendly fire while landing in Tobruk.

text: De moderne Fechtsport gëtt op villen Niveaue bedriwwen, vu Studenten, déi et op enger Uni léieren, bis hin zu professionellen an olympesche Kompetitiounen.
eng_text: The modern sport of fencing is played at many levels, from students learning at a university to professional and Olympic competition.

text: De Sport gëtt gréisstendeels als Duell ausgedroen; ee Fechter duelléiert sech mat engem aneren.
eng_text: The sport is primarily played in a duel format, one fencer dueling another.

text: Golf ass e Spill, bei deem d'Spiller Schléier verwenden, fir Bäll a Lächer ze schloen.
eng_text: Golf is a game in which players use clubs to hit balls into holes.

text: Wärend enger normaler Ronn ginn uechtzéng Lächer gespillt. D'Spiller fänken normalerweis um éischte Lach vun der Golfplaz un an halen um uechtzéngte Lach op.
eng_text: Eighteen holes are played during a regular round, with players usually starting on the first hole on the course and finishing on the eighteenth.

text: De Spiller, deen déi wéinegst Schléi oder Schwéng mam Schléier brauch, fir d'Streck ofzeschléissen, gewënnt.
eng_text: The player who takes the fewest strokes, or swings of the club, to complete the course wins.

text: D'Spill gëtt op Gras gespillt an d'Gras ronderëm d'Lach gëtt méi kuerz geschnidden a Green genannt.
eng_text: The game is played on grass, and the grass around the hole is mown shorter and called the green.

text: Déi vläicht heefegst Aart vun Tourismus ass, wat déi meescht Mënsche mat Reese verbannen: Erhuelungstourismus.
eng_text: Perhaps the most common type of tourism is what most people associate with traveling: Recreation tourism.

text: Dat ass, wann d'Mënschen op eng Plaz ginn, déi sech vun hirem normalen Alldag ënnerscheet, fir ze entspanen a vill Spaass ze hunn.
eng_text: This is when people go to a place that is very different from their regular day-to-day life to relax and have fun.

text: Stränn, Fräizäitparken a Campingplaze sinn dacks déi heefegst Plazen, déi vu Fräizäittouriste besicht ginn.
eng_text: Beaches, theme parks and camp grounds are often the most common places frequented by recreational tourists.

text: Wann eng bestëmmt Plaz besicht gëtt, fir hir Geschicht a Kultur kennenzeléieren, dann ass dës Aart vun Tourismus als Kulturtourismus bekannt.
eng_text: If the objective of one’s visit to a particular place is to get to know its history and culture then this type of tourism is known as cultural tourism.

text: Touriste kënne verschidden Attraktioune vun engem bestëmmte Land besichen oder se kënne sech einfach nëmmen op ee Beräich konzentréieren.
eng_text: Tourists may visit different landmarks of a particular country or they may simply opt to focus on just one area.

text: D'Kolonisten, déi dës Aktivitéit gesinn hunn, haten och Verstäerkung ugefuerdert.
eng_text: The Colonists, seeing this activity, had also called for reinforcements.

text: Truppeverstäerkung an den éischte Reien hunn déi 1. an 3. New-Hampshire-Regimenter vun 200 Mann ënner de Kolonellen John Stark an James Reed (béid goufe spéider Genereel) ëmfaasst.
eng_text: Troops reinforcing the forward positions included the 1st and 3rd New Hampshire regiments of 200 men, under Colonels John Stark and James Reed (both later became generals).

text: Dem Stark seng Männer hu Positioun laanscht dem Zonk um nërdlechen Enn vun der Positioun vun de Koloniste bezunn.
eng_text: Stark's men took positions along the fence on the north end of the Colonist's position.

text: Wéi d'Ebb e Sputt laanscht dem Mystic River laanscht den Nordosten vun der Hallefinsel opgemaach huet, hu se den Zonk séier mat enger Steemauer no Norde verlängert, déi um Rand vum Waasser op engem klenge Strand ophält.
eng_text: When low tide opened a gap along the Mystic River along the northeast of the peninsula, they quickly extended the fence with a short stone wall to the north ending at the water's edge on a small beach.

text: De Gridley oder de Stark hunn ongeféier 30 m (100 Fouss) virum Zonk e Poul ageschloen a befuel, datt kee schéisst, esou laang d'Beruffszaldoten en net passéiert hunn.
eng_text: Gridley or Stark placed a stake about 100 feet (30 m) in front of the fence and ordered that no one fire until the regulars passed it.

text: Den amerikanesche Plang huet op de koordinéierten Ugrëff aus dräi verschiddene Richtunge berout.
eng_text: The American plan relied on launching coordinated attacks from three different directions.

text: Den General John Cadwalder huet en Oflenkungsugrëff géint d'brittesch Garnisoun zu Bordentown gestart, fir Verstäerkungen de Wee ofzeschneiden.
eng_text: General John Cadwalder would launch a diversionary attack against the British garrison at Bordentown, in order to block off any reinforcements.

text: Den General James Ewing huet bei Trenton Ferry 700 Milizen iwwer de Floss bruecht, d'Bréck iwwer den Assunpink Creek ageholl a verhënnert, datt feindlech Truppen flüchten.
eng_text: General James Ewing would take 700 militia across the river at Trenton Ferry, seize the bridge over the Assunpink Creek and prevent any enemy troops from escaping.

text: D'Haaptugrëffskraaft vun 2 400 Mann géif véierzéng Kilometer nërdlech vun Trenton iwwer de Floss goen a sech dann an zwee Gruppen opdeelen, een ënner dem Greene an een ënner dem Sullivan, fir en Ugrëff an aller Herrgottsfréi ze starten.
eng_text: The main assault force of 2,400 men would cross the river nine miles north of Trenton, and then split into two groups, one under Greene and one under Sullivan, in order to launch a pre-dawn attack.

text: Mam Wiessel vum Véierel- zum Hallefkilometerlaf verléiert Geschwindegkeet u Wichtegkeet an Ausdauer gëtt zur absolutter Noutwennegkeet.
eng_text: With the change from the quarter to the half mile run, speed becomes of much less importance and endurance becomes an absolute necessity.

text: Natierlech muss en éischtklassegen Hallefmeile-Leefer, e Mann, deen ënner zwou Minutte bléiwe kann, eng gudd Geschwindegkeet hunn, mee d'Ausdauer muss och op all Fall kultivéiert ginn.
eng_text: Of course a first-class half-miler, a man who can beat two minutes, must be possessed of a fair amount of speed, but endurance must be cultivated at all hazards.

text: E bësse Laanglaf am Wanter, kombinéiert mat Sporthalübunge fir den Uewerkierper ass déi bescht Virbereedung fir d'Lafsaison.
eng_text: Some cross country running during the winter, combined with gymnasium work for the upper part of the body, is the best preparation for the running season.

text: Richteg Ernärungspraktiken eleng kënnen net elitär Leeschtunge generéieren, awer se kënnen dat allgemengt Wuelbefanne vu jonke Sportler weesentlech beaflossen.
eng_text: Proper nutritional practices alone cannot generate elite performances, but they can significantly affect young athletes' overall wellness.

text: D'Oprechterhale vun engem gesonden Energiehaushalt, d'Untrainéiere vun effektiven Drénkgewunnechten an d'Verständnis vun de verschiddenen Aspekter vun der Ergänzung kënnen Athleeten dobäi hëllefen, hir Leeschtung ze verbesseren an hir Freed um Sport ze erhéijen.
eng_text: Maintaining a healthy energy balance, practicing effective hydration habits, and understanding the various aspects of supplementation practices can help athletes improve their performance and increase their enjoyment of the sport.

text: De Mëttelstreckelaf ass e relativ gënschtege Sport; et ginn awer vill Mëssverständnisser a Bezuch op déi wéineg Ausrüstungsgéigestänn, déi fir d'Participatioun erfuerderlech sinn.
eng_text: Middle distance running is a relatively inexpensive sport; however, there are many misconceptions regarding the few pieces of equipment required to participate.

text: Produkter kënne bei Bedarf kaaft ginn, awer déi meescht hunn nëmmen eng geréng oder keng wierklech Auswierkung op d'Leeschtung.
eng_text: Products can be purchased as needed, but most will have little or no real impact on performance.

text: Athleete kënnen d'Gefill hunn, datt se ee Produkt bevirzuchen, och wann et keng wierklech Virdeeler bitt.
eng_text: Athletes may feel that they prefer a product even when it provides no real benefits.

text: Den Atom kann als ee vun de grondleeënde Bausteng vun all Materie betruecht ginn.
eng_text: The atom can be considered to be one of the fundamental building blocks of all matter.

text: Et ass eng ganz komplex Eenheet, déi laut engem vereinfachte Bohr-Modell aus engem vun Elektronen ëmkreesten Zentralkär besteet, änlech Planéiten, déi d'Sonn ëmkreesen – kuckt Ofbildung 1.1.
eng_text: Its a very complex entity which consists, according to a simplified Bohr model, of a central nucleus orbited by electrons, somewhat similar to planets orbiting the sun - see Figure 1.1.

text: Neutronen a Protone sinn déi zwee Deelercher, déi den Zellkär bilden.
eng_text: The nucleus consists of two particles - neutrons and protons.

text: Protonen si positiv gelueden, wärend Neutrone keng Charge hunn. D'Elektronen sinn negativ gelueden.
eng_text: Protons have a positive electric charge while neutrons have no charge. The electrons have a negative electric charge.

text: Fir d'Affer ze ënnersichen, musst Dir fir d'éischt de Site iwwerpréiwen, fir Är Sécherheet ze garantéieren.
eng_text: To Check the victim, you must first survey the scene to ensure your safety.

text: Dir musst d'Positioun vum Affer an all méiglech Warnsignaler erkennen, wann Dir beim Affer ukommt.
eng_text: You need to notice the victim's position as you approach him or her and any automatic red flags.

text: Wann Dir beim Versuch ze hëllefen, verletzt gitt, da kann et sinn, datt Dir alles nëmmen nach verschlëmmert.
eng_text: If you get hurt trying to help, you may only serve to make matters worse.

text: D'Studie huet erausfonnt, datt Depressioun, Angscht a Katastrophiséieren d'Bezéiung tëschent Péng a Behënnerung bei Patienten mat Péng am ënneschte Réckberäich erbäiféieren.
eng_text: The study found that depression, fear and catastrophising mediated the relationship between pain and disability in lower back pain sufferers.

text: Nëmmen d'Auswierkunge vu Katastrophen, net Depressioun an Angscht ware vu reegelméissege wéchentlech strukturéierte PA-Sëtzungen ofhängeg.
eng_text: Only the effects of catastrophizing, not depression and fear was conditional of regular weekly structured PA sessions.

text: Déijéineg, déi u reegelméissegen Aktivitéiten deelhuelen, hu méi Ënnerstëtzung a Bezuch op d'negativ Warneemung vu Péng beim Ënnerscheede vun den Ënnerscheeder tëschent chronescher Péng an dem Gefill vu liichter Péng bei normaler kierperlecher Beweegung gebraucht.
eng_text: Those participating in regular activity required more support in terms of negative perception of pain distinguishing the differences of chronic pain and discomfort feel from normal physical movement.

text: D'Siicht oder d'Fäegkeet ze gesinn, hänkt vun de Sënnesorganer vum visuelle System oder den Aen of.
eng_text: Vision, or the ability to see depends on visual system sensory organs or eyes.

text: Et gëtt vill verschidden Aekonstruktiounen, déi an der Komplexitéit jee no den Ufuerderunge vum Organismus breet gefächert sinn.
eng_text: There are many different constructions of eyes, ranging in complexity depending on the requirements of the organism.

text: Déi verschidde Konstruktiounen hunn ënnerschiddlech Asazméiglechkeeten, sinn empfindlech op ënnerschiddlech Wellelängten an hunn ënnerschiddlech Seeschäerftgraden, se erfuerderen och eng ënnerschiddlech Veraarbechtung, datt et Sënn fir den Input ergëtt an fir datt ënnerschiddlech Zuelen optimal funktionéieren.
eng_text: The different constructions have different capabilities, are sensitive to different wave-lengths and have differing degrees of acuity, also they require different processing to make sense of the input and different numbers to work optimally.

text: Eng Populatioun ass eng Usammlung vun Organismusse vun enger bestëmmter Aart an engem gewësse geografesche Beräich.
eng_text: A population is the collection of organisms of a particular species within a given geographic area.

text: Wann all Individuen an enger Populatioun hisichtlech enger bestëmmter phenotypescher Eegenschaft identesch sinn, gi se als monomorph bezeechent.
eng_text: When all individuals in a population are identical with regard to a particular phenotypic trait they are known as monomorphic.

text: Wann d'Individue méi Variante vun enger bestëmmter Eegenschaft weisen, si se polymorph.
eng_text: When the individuals show several variants of a particular trait they are polymorphic.

text: Arméiseejomeskolonien marschéieren an nisten och a verschiddene Phasen.
eng_text: Army ant colonies march and nest in different phases as well.

text: An der nomadescher Phas marschéieren Arméiseejomessen nuets an halen daagsiwwer un, fir hiert Lager opzeschloen.
eng_text: In the nomadic phase, army ants march at night and stop to camp during the day.

text: D'Kolonie fänkt an enger nomadescher Phas un, wann d'verfügbar Narung zeréckgeet. Wärend der éischter Phas baut d'Kolonie zäitweileg Näschter, déi all Dag gewiesselt ginn.
eng_text: The colony begins a nomadic phase when available food has decreased. During this phase, the colony makes temporary nests that are changed everyday.

text: Jiddwer eenzele vun dësen nomadesche Sträifzich oder Märsch dauert zirka 17 Deeg.
eng_text: Each of these nomadic rampages or marches lasts for approximately 17 days.

text: Wat definéiert eng Zell? D'Wuert Zell staamt vum laténgesche Begrëff "cella" a bedeit "klenge Raum" a gouf fir d'éischt vun engem Mikroskopist an d'Liewe geruff, deen d'Struktur vu Kork beobacht huet.
eng_text: What is a cell? The word cell comes from the Latin word "cella", meaning "small room", and it was first coined by a microscopist observing the structure of cork.

text: D'Zell ass d'Grondeenheet vun alle Liewewiesen an all Organismusse bestinn aus enger oder méi Zellen.
eng_text: The cell is the basic unit of all living things, and all organisms are composed of one or more cells.

text: Zelle sinn esou grondleeënd a wichteg fir d'Studium vum Liewen, datt se tatsächlech dacks als "Bausteng vum Liewe" bezeechent ginn.
eng_text: Cells are so basic and critical to the study of life, in fact, that they are often referred to as "the building blocks of life".

text: Den Nervesystem hält d'Homeostas, andeem en Nervenimpulser duerch de Kierper schéckt, fir de Bluttfloss ongestéiert ze halen.
eng_text: The Nervous System maintains homeostasis by sending nerve impulses through out the body to keep the flow of blood going as well as undisturbed.

text: Dës Nervenimpulser kënnen esou séier duerch de ganze Kierper geschéckt ginn, wat hëlleft, de Kierper sécher vu méigleche Bedroungen ze halen.
eng_text: These nerve impulses can be sent so quickly throughout the body which helps keep the body safe from any potential threat.

text: Tornadoe treffen am Verglach zu anere staarke Stierm e kleng Gebitt, se kënnen awer alles op hirem Wee zerstéieren.
eng_text: Tornadoes strike a small area compared to other violent storms, but they can destroy everything in their path.

text: Tornadoen entwuerzele Beem, räisse Brieder vu Gebaier a schleideren Autoen an den Himmel. Déi stäerkst zwee Prozent vun den Tornadoen dauere méi ewéi dräi Stonnen.
eng_text: Tornadoes uproot trees, rip boards from buildings, and fling cars up into the sky. The most violent two percent of tornadoes last more than three hours.

text: Dës Monsterstierm hu Wandgeschwindegkeete vu bis zu 480 km/h (133 m/s; 300 mph).
eng_text: These monster storms have winds up to 480 km/h (133 m/s; 300 mph).

text: Mënschen hunn Dausenden an Dausende vu Joer Lënse fir d'Vergréisserung hiergestallt a benotzt.
eng_text: Humans have been making and using lenses for magnification for thousands and thousands of years.

text: Déi éischt richteg Teleskoper goufen awer Enn vum 16. Joerhonnert an Europa hiergestallt.
eng_text: However, the first true telescopes were made in Europe in the late 16th century.

text: Dës Teleskoper hunn eng Kombinatioun aus zwou Lënse verwent, fir wäit ewech Objete méi no a méi grouss erschéngen ze loossen.
eng_text: These telescopes used a combination of two lenses to make distant objects appear both nearer and larger.

text: Gier an Egoismus wäerten eis ëmmer begleeden an et läit an der Natur vun der Zesummenaarbecht, datt wann d'Majortéit profitéiert, et kuerzfristeg ëmmer méi ze gewanne gëtt, wann een egoistesch handelt.
eng_text: Greed and selfishness will always be with us and it is the nature of cooperation that when the majority benefit there will always be more to gain in the short term by acting selfishly

text: Hoffentlech erkennen déi meescht Mënschen, datt et laangfristeg déi bescht Optioun ass, mat aneren zesummezeschaffen.
eng_text: Hopefully, most people will realise that their long term best option is to work together with others.

text: Vill Leit dreeme vum Dag, un deem d'Mënschen op en anere Stär reesen an aner Welten erfuersche kënnen; e puer Leit froe sech, wat dobaussen ass, e puer gleewen, datt eventuell Ausserierdescher oder anert Liewen op anere Planéite existéieren.
eng_text: Many people dream of the day when humans can travel to another star and explore other worlds, some people wonder what's out there some belive that aliens or other life may live on another plant.

text: Awer, wann dat jeemools passéiert, da warscheinlech net ganz laang. D'Stäre sinn esou verdeelt, datt Billioune vu Kilometer tëschent "Nopeschstäre" leien.
eng_text: But, if this ever does happen probably won't happen for a very long time. The stars are so spread out that there are trillions of miles between stars that are "neighbors".

text: Vläicht sinn Är Urenkelen enges Daags op enger friemer Welt a wonnere sech iwwer hir al Virfaren?
eng_text: Maybe one day, your great grandchildren will be standing atop an alien world wondering about their ancient ancestors?

text: Déiere bestinn aus villen Zellen. Se iesse Saachen a verdaue se am Kierper. Déi meescht Déiere kënne sech fortbeweegen.
eng_text: Animals are made of many cells. They eat things and digest them inside. Most animals can move.

text: Nëmmen Déieren hu Gehierer (och wann dat net bei allen Déieren de Fall ass; Jelliskäpp hunn zum Beispill kee Gehier).
eng_text: Only animals have brains (though not even all animals do; jellyfish, for example, do not have brains).

text: Déiere ginn et op der ganzer Welt. Se gruewe sech duerch de Buedem, schwammen an den Ozeaner a fléien um Himmel.
eng_text: Animals are found all over the earth. They dig in the ground, swim in the oceans, and fly in the sky.

text: Eng Zell ass déi klengst strukturell a funktionell Eenheet vun engem liewegen Organismus/enger Saach.
eng_text: A cell is the smallest structural and functional unit of a living (things) organism.

text: Zell staamt aus dem laténgesche Wuert 'cella', dat klenge Raum bedeit.
eng_text: Cell comes from the Latin word cella which means small room.

text: Wann Dir Iech Liewewiesen ënner engem Mikroskop ukuckt, da gesitt Dir, datt se aus klenge Quadrater oder Kugele bestinn.
eng_text: If you look at living things under a microscope, you will see that they are made of small squares or balls.

text: De Robert Hooke, e Biolog aus England, huet mat engem Mikroskop kleng Quadrater am Kork gesinn.
eng_text: Robert Hooke, a biologist from England, saw small squares in cork with a microscope.

text: Se hunn ewéi Zëmmer ausgesinn. Hie war den Éischten, deen doudeg Zelle beobacht huet.
eng_text: They looked like rooms. He was the first person to observe dead cells

text: Elementer a Verbindunge kënne sech vun engem Zoustand an en anere verschiben a sech net änneren.
eng_text: Elements and compounds can move from one state to another and not change.

text: Stéckstoff als Gas huet ëmmer nach déi selwecht Eegenschaften ewéi flëssege Stéckstoff. De flëssegen Zoustand ass méi dicht, awer d'Molekülle sinn ëmmer nach déi selwecht.
eng_text: Nitrogen as a gas still has the same properties as liquid nitrogen. The liquid state is denser but the molecules are still the same.

text: Waasser ass e weidert Beispill. D'Waasserverbindung besteet aus zwee Waasserstoffatomer an engem Sauerstoffatom.
eng_text: Water is another example. The compound water is made up of two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.

text: Et huet déi selwecht molekular Struktur, egal ob et e Gas, eng Flëssegkeet oder e Feststoff ass.
eng_text: It has the same molecular structure whether it is a gas, liquid, or solid.

text: Obwuel de physikalesche Status ännere kann, bleift de cheemesche Status onverännert.
eng_text: Although its physical state may change, its chemical state remains the same.

text: Zäit ass eppes, dat iwwerall ëm eis erëm ass an alles beaflosst, wat mir maachen, awer net einfach verständlech ass.
eng_text: Time is something that is all around us, and affects everything we do, yet is difficult to understand.

text: D'Zäit gouf vu reliéisen, philosopheschen a wëssenschaftleche Geléierten zanter Dausende vu Jore studéiert.
eng_text: Time has been studied by religious, philosophical, and scientific scholars for thousands of years.

text: Mir erliewen Zäit als eng Rëtsch vun Ereegnesser, déi vun der Zukunft iwwer d'Géigewaart an d'Vergaangenheet iwwerginn.
eng_text: We experience time as a series of events passing from the future through the present to the past.

text: Mat der Zäit vergläiche mir och d'Dauer (Längt) vun Ereegnesser.
eng_text: Time is also how we compare the duration (length) of events.
